info.name: Skill Loop Backend - Full API Test Suite
info.description:
GENERATED from docs/scalar-test-plan.json - do not edit by hand.
Regenerate: python docs/generate_test_artifacts.py

HOW TO RUN
  1. Import this file into Postman (Import > Link/Disk).
  2. Start the API: dotnet run --project src/Skill-Loop.Api
  3. Set collection variable student1Otp / student2Otp / invitationToken manually.
  4. Edit any file paths marked 'EDIT THIS PATH before running'.
  5. Collection > Run (Ctrl+Alt+R). It executes all steps in order and each
     response feeds the next request automatically.

Docker is NOT required. Scalar is served in-process at /scalar/v1.

request.description: Open this URL directly in the browser first. If it 404s the environment is not Development, so Scalar is not mapped.
